copy.blurb: Ecuador should win this one, and the price already knows it — the model lands within a point of The Market on all three sides, both pricing Ecuador as the clear favourite. The agreement is the point: when a strong side is also a short price, there's rarely a gap to find, and forcing one would be the opposite of useful. The model rates Ecuador at 76%; the market has them at 78%. Close enough that the only honest verdict is Pass. We'll revisit near kickoff, when the confirmed eleven and any fitness news land — those are what move a settled favourite, not the prior.
drivers: Model and market sit within a percentage point on every side.
No real disagreement to publish — both are pricing the same shape.
Form, the confirmed line-ups, and weather get weighed closer to kickoff.
copy.summary: The Market's line on Ecuador v Curaçao already sits where the model does, to within a point on every side. Pass: the price has done the work.
